body.name: dref
body.def: For a dataset \(\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho}\) realized at a fixed \(\rho\), \(d^{\mathrm{ref}}_n(B,\rho,\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho})=\sup_{j=(C,s)\in J,\,\theta\in[0,\pi/2]^J,\,x\in\mathbb R}\max\{\lvert F^{\mathrm{ref}}_{n,j}(x;\rho,\theta_j,\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho})-G^0_j(x;\rho,\theta_j)\rvert,\lvert q^{\mathrm{ref}}_{n,j}(\rho,\theta_j,\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho})-q_{\alpha,j}(\rho,\theta_j)\rvert\}\).
